title: Ruby and the Leafy Egg | Read Along | Luna Story Time
description:
Ruby and her dragon friends follow a rumble into a cave, help a hurt creature, and comfort a frightened leafy egg. When Leaf hatches, they find a way to help rebuild a castle together.

Book Four of Ruby and the Dragon Bonds. Written with love by Luna, Sunny, and Mommy.

Listen and follow the highlighted words through this illustrated read-along, with a gentle original score.
